scope: Compare IRQ return/refill observations from a common retired-handler state; diagnostics and immutable shared reference fixture only
assets: Synthetic ADD streams and NOP/SUBS handler only; no user ROM/BIOS/save

comparison.scope: Cycle origin is the retired handler NOP. Shared fixtures contain only complete NBA/mGBA agreements on cycles, PC, CPSR, LR and r0. No tolerance or host-based selection. Absolute IRQ assertion/entry latency is outside this comparison.

validation.actual_cldc_scope: Portable/MIDP source unchanged; retained actual ECJ/CLDC core observations are unchanged.

interface.inputs: Three complete five-stage CSV traces with --full-trace --extended-pages
interface.normalization: Subtract only each scenario handler-NOP retirement clock. All PC/CPSR/LR/r0 anchor fields must agree before alignment.
interface.oracle: Use complete NBA/mGBA agreements on cycle/PC/CPSR/LR/r0, independently of the host. Retain all 92 disputed observations in JSON.
interface.exit_codes: 0 = complete shared phase exact with no reference disagreement; 1 = unqualified; 2 = invalid inputs/stale output. Matching only the shared subset cannot return 0.

reference.freshness: New expanded traces from the existing pinned unmodified core libraries. The adapters add optional two-slot page lookahead coverage; default 162-row output stays byte-identical to the prior fixture.

results.next: Qualify a generic prefetch-aware refill path against this shared fixture and the game/state gates. Do not resolve the disputed rows by choosing the closest model.

reproduction: Run all adapters with --full-trace --extended-pages; follow docs/SCENARIOS.md#cartridge-fetch-stream-after-irq-return. Baseline retains 92 reference differences and 56 host/shared differences, with exit 1. Default no-option output remains identical to the previous 162-row fixture.
